salvaged_lemmas.title: Lemma A: Length, Specialization, and Finite Jets over k[[t]]
salvaged_lemmas.statement: For any n-by-n matrix A(t) over k[[t]] with non-zero determinant and M = coker A: length(M) = ord_t(det A) = sum e_i, and dim_k(M/tM) = d. Then ord_t(det A) - d = sum_{e_i>0}(e_i - 1) >= 0, with equality iff tM = 0.
salvaged_lemmas.verification: Self-reviewed algebraic derivation in RESEARCH.md; 155 SymPy matrix fixtures in specialization.py.

salvaged_lemmas.title: Lemma B: First-Order Bockstein Derivative Criterion
salvaged_lemmas.statement: ord_t(det A) = dim ker A(0) if and only if the induced map beta: ker A_0 -> coker A_0 (v -> A_1*v mod im A_0) is invertible.
salvaged_lemmas.verification: Proved via Schur complement in RESEARCH.md; checked across 155 test matrices.

salvaged_lemmas.title: Lemma C: Anti-Hermitian Duality Obstruction Theorem
salvaged_lemmas.statement: Anti-Hermitian duality A(-t)^T = -A(t) alone does not eliminate higher augmentation blocks. Paired skew-symmetric matrices diag([[0, t^e], [-t^e, 0]]) satisfy all duality constraints but have order 2e and specialized dimension 2.
salvaged_lemmas.verification: Proved in RESEARCH.md Section 3; verified in specialization.py.

salvaged_lemmas.title: Lemma D: Kummer 2-Descent Point Independence on E_41
salvaged_lemmas.statement: Rational points P=(-9,120) and Q=(841, 24360) have Kummer square-class triples delta(P)=(-1,-2,2) and delta(Q)=(1,2,2) which are independent modulo rational torsion in (Q*/(Q*)^2)^3. Hence rank E_41(Q) = 2, matching Monsky's upper bound.
salvaged_lemmas.verification: Exact coordinates on curve; 2-torsion injection checked at primes 3 and 5; Kummer homomorphism certified.

salvaged_lemmas.title: Lemma E: Burungale-Tian 2-Converse Bridge for Congruent Curves
salvaged_lemmas.statement: For congruent curves E_n with rational 2-torsion dimension 2, dim Sel_2(E_n) = 2 forces the full 2-primary Selmer group Sel_(2^infinity)(E_n) = 0 without assuming Sha finite. By Burungale-Tian Theorem 1.1, this forces L(E_n, 1) != 0.
salvaged_lemmas.verification: Proven via Kummer exact sequences in experiments/converse.md; verified on 58/58 baseline curves.
